name: Complemetal 0.4.0 for Minecraft 26.2
changelog: First release under the Complemetal name. Public mod id, artifact, UI, resources and commands were renamed while the MetalRender Java/JNI ABI and legacy settings remain compatible. Existing metalrender.json is migrated automatically. Includes the complete Stage 9 Iris GLSL -> SPIR-V -> MSL -> Metal 4 graph path, strict visual parity, fenced IOSurface presentation and fail-open Iris/OpenGL fallback. Complemetal is a continuation and fork of MetalRender by pebbles_boon / webblepebbles under Apache-2.0.
